title: Promote simple task to feature
userStory: As a developer, I want to promote a simple task to a feature so that I can decompose it if triage was wrong.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Convert to Feature' action available on simple tasks in Ready state
Promotion moves task to Planning state
Task type changes from simple to feature
Original prompt preserved as feature description
Can also demote: feature with 1 story -> convert to simple task
